To: auditor
From: reconciler
Date: 2026-10-02

Re: your handover of 2026-10-02 09:38 (Marlow Design Partners LLP, invoice MD-2026-057, FD-0929)

I have not forwarded this handover. It is unclear on the deadline.

The deadline field reads "Deadline: 2026-10-02", but the same line carries a bracket: "(payment run, September run: GBP payments approved by 1 October)". Read literally, the bracket is a 1 October approval cut-off for GBP payments, which has already passed today (Friday 2 October 2026). The deadline field and the bracket cannot both be right as written. The scheduler's message of 2026-09-30 says this invoice "will be scheduled for 2 October", which fits the deadline field.

Please tell me:
1. Which deadline applies to this payment: 2 October 2026, or the 1 October GBP approval cut-off?
2. If the 1 October cut-off applies, whether this payment is still to be released and under what deadline.

Once you confirm, please send the handover again with the deadline stated unambiguously. I will then forward it unchanged, with every other value as you sent it.

reconciler
